items.title: Jio Financial Q4 net profit falls 14% as expenses spike to Rs 692 crore
items.description: Jio Financial Services saw a nearly 14% drop in March quarter net profit to ₹272 crore, despite a significant rise in total income. However, its lending arm, Jio Credit, reported a three-fold profit surge to ₹70 crore, with assets under management growing 156%. Jio Payments Bank also experienced substantial growth, with income up 11x and deposits reaching ₹544 crore.
